# `scripts/pkdgrav3_pipeline/archive_run.py`

Source: [archive_run.py](../../../../scripts/pkdgrav3_pipeline/archive_run.py)

```text
Copy the kept part of a run (retention.py) from SCRATCH to ARCHIVE, check the copy, then make it read-only
(stage `archive`, job_archive.pbs). Nothing in SCRATCH is changed or deleted.

Steps (restartable: files already copied and checked are skipped):
  1. refuses unless <state>/verify.json passed and is newer than every kept file (no stage ran after it)
  2. each file: read once, SHA-256 while copying to <dest>.part, fsync, rename
  3. each copied file read back from ARCHIVE with O_DIRECT (dd iflag=direct: from the disk, not the page cache)
     and its SHA-256 compared with the source's
  4. MANIFEST.json and SHA256SUMS in ARCHIVE/state/<stem>/r<real>/ (cd ARCHIVE; sha256sum -c that file), a copy in
     the scratch state dir; event archive_done
  5. read-only: files ARCHIVE_FILE_MODE (0444), the run's directories ARCHIVE_DIR_MODE (0555), manifest last
     (shared directories, e.g. sims/<stem>/ with cosmology.txt, keep their mode; their files become read-only)

Runs computed on another site (REMOTE_ARCHIVE=1 in run.conf, e.g. pegasus), archived on pawna:
  archive_run.py <run.conf> --source-sums   on the computing site, at the end of the verify job: step 1, then size,
                                            mtime and SHA-256 of every kept file -> <state>/KEPT_FILES.json
  archive_run.py <mirror run.conf>          on pawna, when the config sets PULL_HOST (user@data node) and
                                            REMOTE_SCRATCH (the manager writes such a config): the files of
                                            KEPT_FILES.json pulled with rsync over ssh from PULL_HOST into ARCHIVE,
                                            each read back (O_DIRECT) and compared with the source's SHA-256; logs and
                                            event files (still growing after the sums) are compared by rsync only;
                                            then steps 4-5 as above
Batches while the run is computed (archive_run.py <run.conf> --particles-upto N; job_archive.pbs with ARCHIVE_UPTO,
started by the manager each time a snapshot kept in full is written): the kept particle files (pkc_full, pkc_sub) of
snapshots 0..N are copied (or, with PULL_HOST, pulled: size, mtime and SHA-256 taken on the data node) into ARCHIVE,
read back with O_DIRECT and compared, and recorded in <state>/archive_partial.json. No verify needed, no manifest,
nothing made read-only: the final archive (above) skips these files (same size and mtime, checked copy) and does the
rest. So most of the particle data, the bulk of a run, is archived while the simulation runs.

usage: archive_run.py <run.conf> [--dry-run] [--no-lock] [--source-sums] [--particles-upto N]
```

## makedirs_g

```python
makedirs_g(d)
```

os.makedirs, with group read and search on every directory it creates (whatever the umask).

## sha_copy

```python
sha_copy(src, dst)
```

Copy `src` to `dst` and return the SHA-256 (hex) of the bytes copied.

Written to `dst.part`, fsynced, given the source's times and mode plus group read, then renamed, so an
interrupted copy never leaves a truncated file under the final name.

## sha_file

```python
sha_file(path)
```

SHA-256 (hex) of a file, read in `CHUNK` blocks.

## sha_direct

```python
sha_direct(path)
```

SHA-256 of the file as stored (O\_DIRECT read, bypassing this node's page cache).

## main

```python
main()
```

Command line: `archive_run.py <run.conf> [--dry-run] [...]`.

Refuses an ARCHIVE that is, contains or lies inside SCRATCH, then copies the kept files (local run), pulls
them from the run's site (remote run) or copies a batch of particle outputs (see the module docstring).

## checked_files

```python
checked_files(E, pl)
```

verify.json passed and no kept file changed after it -&gt; (verify report, kept files).

## locked_complete

```python
locked_complete(M, man_path, wanted)
```

A complete, read-only archive counts as this run's archive only if it holds every kept data file of the
current verify; otherwise (kept files added since, e.g. the Parquet copy of stage parquet) fail: it is not
extended in place, so nothing is trashed or purged on the strength of an archive that lacks files.

## same_source

```python
same_source(man_path, src_scratch)
```

Exit if ARCHIVE already holds this run name from another run (another site's SCRATCH): the archive path has no
site in it (pegasus and swarm L100N128/default128/r1 both archived to the same directory).

## copy_local

```python
copy_local(E, pl, P, V, files, dry)
```

Copy the kept files `files` of a local run into the archive and write its manifest.

A locked (read-only) complete archive is only checked against `files`; otherwise each file whose archive
copy is missing or differs (size, mtime, SHA-256) is copied with `sha_copy` and re-read from the
archive to verify it. `V` is the verify report, `dry` lists without copying. Returns the exit code.
